sentences.en: He is an amateur gardener, but his flowers are beautiful.
sentences.zh: 他是一个业余园丁，但他的花非常漂亮。

sentences.en: Weeds are nature's opposition against the rule of the gardeners.
sentences.zh: 杂草是大自然对园丁统治的反抗。

sentences.en: Our bodies are our gardens, to which our wills are gardeners.
sentences.zh: 我们的身体就像花园，而意志则是花园里的园丁。

senses.zh: 园丁，园艺家,花匠,菜农,园艺爱好者
